description: Start making new reels: one per theme from the newest footage (clips picked by the studio, approved words, licence-clean music), each queued to render one after another. Returns the new slugs; follow each with job_status. Rendering takes minutes per reel. The new reels still need a person's review and approval in the studio before they can be published.

cut.description: short = the looping reel; long = a 40-60 s explainer for LinkedIn and Facebook.

faces.description: Allow clips with faces (they then need consent or Blur faces before approval).

since.description: Use footage shot on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the last 60 days.

themes.description: Theme keys from list_themes. Leave out for every theme.

vary.description: Give each reel a different text layout and effects.

name: make_reels
title: Make reels (autopilot)
